description: Filter UK planning entities by dataset, typology, publisher reference, curie or publishing organisation. NOTE: planning.data.gov.uk has NO free-text search — its documented `q` parameter is silently ignored upstream and returns the whole 25-million-row platform, so this tool does not accept one. To find a designation by place, use ukplanning_entities_at_point instead. Use this for "list the conservation areas published by organisation X", "which entity has reference CA18", "how many brownfield-land records exist". Example: ukplanning_search({ dataset: "conservation-area", reference: "CA18" })

entry_date_year.description: Restrict to records first entered in this year, e.g. 2026

include_geometry.description: Include the full WKT boundary of each row (default false)

organisation_entity.description: Entity id of the publishing organisation (a local planning authority), e.g. 278

reference.description: The publisher's own reference for the entity, e.g. "CA18". NOT unique across councils — pair with organisation_entity

name: ukplanning_search
title: Ukplanning Search
